message: 3人寄らば天使です

name: Misa
message: 「Hellooo~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, Synn? What are you doing all by yourself?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just as you can see, breezing right through making costumes」

name: Ria
message: 「No... that's not what I meant.... Where's Lolotte?」

name: Synn
message: 「Every now and then, it's nice for angels to have some alone time... right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, let's gooo~♪」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Azel. If you don't keep up properly, you'll get left behind」

name: Azel
message: 「Ah, r-right...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Where are we heading off to explore today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hate to disappoint you when you're so excited, but today we're just going on a normal shopping trip」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hoho~~. That sounds fun in its own way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And to deliver a double whammy of apologies to you, Azel, we aren't going out to buy food either」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I am not ruled by my appetite!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Don't worry. Lolotte said she'll treat us to her home cooking again for dinner」

name: Azel
message: 「Stop treating me like a glutton!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the harm? Birds of a feather--no secrets between fellow angels, right\s07」

name: Azel
message: 「Gah... say whatever you want」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So, what are we buying?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm thinking of buying yarn in all sorts of different colors」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yarn...?」

name: Azel
message: 「Something like that... what on earth could you possibly need it for」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Please keep this a secret from everyone else. I'm going to use this yarn to do some knitting」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Knitting~~!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph... What is the point of making such a thing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Physical things remain in a tangible form, you see. That's why I was thinking of making Christmas presents out of yarn」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Christmas presents!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Presents for everyone who always takes such good care of me」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Wait, if it's a secret... does that mean for those of us you just confided in, could it be--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unfortunately, you'll have to wait」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That really is unfortunate...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I wanted the two of you to help me pick out colors that people would be happy to receive」

name: Azel
message: 「Why must we do something like that...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Now, now, don't go sulking just because you aren't getting one」

name: Azel
message: 「I am not sulking!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't worry. Once I finish making everyone else's, I'll make ones for the two of you as well」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you, I--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Heehee. Honestly, Azel, you're just so stubborn about admitting how you feel」

name: Azel
message: 「Guh... I swear... I'll kill you two one day」
